title: Additive-field exact analytic refinement objective (surfel plus visibility weighting) versus point-sampled compositing supervision
question: On native additive 2D Gaussian fields, does refining a matched image-free 3D initialization with the exact analytic density/RGB-numerator objective under surfel-constrained covariances and detached transmittance-times-incidence per-view weighting improve held-out compact reconstruction over the incumbent point-sampled compositing objective, and does an analytic-warmup-then-sampled-finish hybrid beat both?
hypothesis: At matched initialization, fixed topology, and matched optimizer budget, the hybrid arm reduces final held-out additive-field RGB MSE by at least 5% geometric mean versus the point-sampled baseline and wins at least two of three paired seeds on each of the two outcome-exposed scenes; the visibility-weighted analytic arm outperforms the unweighted analytic arm on the same paired cells; and under weighting the residual-energy share carried by occluded primitives drops relative to the unweighted arm (descriptive diagnostic).
claim_boundary: Development and replication evidence about four named CPU refinement-objective arms on outcome-exposed frames 00008 and 00009 using native additive 2D Gaussian fields with zero support fade, where the analytic density/RGB-numerator objective is exact rather than the normalized-blend proxy. It cannot establish StructSplat or normalized-blend behavior, RGB quality against photographs, GPU behavior, speed, cross-dataset generalization, topology or densification effects, or a production-default change. The additive-versus-StructSplat stage-1 quality trade is explicitly deferred by owner decision of 2026-07-30.

shared_initialization.note: one deterministic placement per scene and seed, shared bit-exact across all four arms

refinement_provisional_until_implementat.point_sampled_budget_rule: matched to the analytic arms by equal optimizer steps and equal per-step supervision sample count; the exact sampler fields are frozen together with the driver before review

stages.label: Additive teacher load
stages.purpose: Load the frozen additive native fields and hard-assert blend_mode additive with zero support fade so the analytic objective is exact rather than the documented normalized-blend proxy.

stages.label: Matched image-free initialization
stages.purpose: Build one deterministic source-anchored bounded-midpoint placement per scene and seed, shared bit-exact across arms, so later metrics isolate the refinement objective and not placement.

stages.label: Per-arm objective refinement
stages.purpose: Refine the shared initialization under each arm's supervision surface at matched iteration and supervision budget with fixed topology, so the objective is the only manipulated factor.

stages.label: Held-out compact evaluation
stages.purpose: Evaluate immutable held-out additive teachers only after each arm finishes, preserving per-view, per-seed, per-scene diagnostics and the per-primitive transmittance-times-energy conflict-score table.

comparators.label: Point-sampled compositing baseline
comparators.purpose: Incumbent supervision surface; controls whether analytic supervision adds value over sampled true-semantics supervision at matched initialization and budget.

comparators.label: Unweighted analytic objective
comparators.purpose: Controls the occlusion mechanism; runs the same exact additive objective without per-view transmittance-times-incidence weights, so any weighted-arm gain is attributable to visibility handling.

comparators.label: Visibility-weighted analytic objective
comparators.purpose: Isolates the analytic-only endpoint run to full budget, so the hybrid arm's sampled finish is attributable rather than confounded with the warm-up.

primary_metrics.label: Final held-out compact RGB MSE
primary_metrics.aggregation: sample-weighted held-out views, paired by scene and seed; the decision rule is hybrid versus point-sampled baseline with at least 5% geometric-mean improvement and at least two of three paired seed wins per scene

primary_metrics.label: Final held-out compact density MSE
primary_metrics.aggregation: sample-weighted held-out views, paired by scene and seed

primary_metrics.label: Shared-initialization held-out RGB MSE
primary_metrics.aggregation: recorded once per scene and seed as the matched-start receipt; must be bit-identical across arms within a cell

primary_metrics.label: Occluded-primitive penalty share
primary_metrics.aggregation: per arm, scene, and seed: the share of training-view analytic residual energy carried by primitives whose detached center transmittance in that view is below 0.1; diagnostic for the occlusion hypothesis with no decision authority

primary_metrics.label: Source projection maximum error
primary_metrics.aggregation: maximum over every arm, scene, and seed; structural guardrail at 0.0002 pixels

primary_metrics.label: CPU wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: descriptive per-arm and per-scene medians over three measured seeds; the root summary is the median of all measured cells and supports no performance claim

resource_protocol.scope: fresh single-thread CPU process per scene, seed, and arm from additive-manifest open through final field validation and atomic artifact save; arm order is counterbalanced across measured seeds
resource_protocol.aggregation: one discarded warmup per scene and arm, followed by three paired measured seeds; retain every raw scene, seed, arm, end-to-end time, worker time, output size, and ru_maxrss; timings are descriptive only

blockers: The surfel-constrained visibility-weighted exact analytic objective, the hybrid schedule, and the matched point-sampled budget rule are not implemented; land them behind existing seams with CPU tests (analytic-equals-rendered-image exactness on additive fields, occlusion-weighting behavior, determinism), then confirm or amend every value under frozen_configuration.refinement_provisional_until_implementation.
Write scripts/experiments/20260730_additive_analytic_objective_stage_frames00008_00009.py and freeze the exact run_command.

Obtain the distinct prospective protocol review (review-digest, experiments/reviews/20260730_additive_analytic_objective_stage_frames00008_00009_PROTOCOL_REVIEW.md, Outcome Access: none) and set status ready.
